The Benue State Police Command has said that a total of 29 kidnap victims were rescued within the month of October across the state. The State Commissioner of Police, Cletus Nwadiogbu, stated this at a press conference held at the command headquarters in Makurdi on Tuesday. He stated that the rescue of the kidnap victims was made possible with the collaboration of other sister agencies across the state. The CP further said that 34 foreign nationals were also arrested within the month for clandestine activities. He said, “On 9th October 2026, operatives of the Command arrested 16 Cameroonian nationals in Otukpo Local Government Area. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. The state police boss said that the Command was already taking steps to establish the relevant facts and involve the appropriate authorities, including the Nigeria Immigration Service, for profiling and any further action required under the law. The Police Commissioner further said that the command, in separate operations, arrested the suspected cultists in Naka, Makurdi and Aliade of Gwer West, Makurdi and Gwer East, respectively. The Police Commissioner listed Items recovered from the operations within the month to include: seven locally fabricated firearms recovered, 16 ammunition and cartridges, charms, mobile phones and ATM cards.
